title: Periodic Telemetry Reporting
description: The firmware shall periodically transmit telemetry frames over USART2 every 2000 ms under normal operational conditions.
source: main loop HAL_Delay(2000) at 0x80012f0 and HAL_UART_Transmit at 0x80012ec

title: Valid Telemetry Format
description: Under normal sensor operation, the UART transmission shall contain formatted sensor data matching 'Humidity: %d Temperature: %d'.
source: rodata format string at 0x8001d62 referenced by main at 0x8001304

title: Sensor Fault Indication
description: When the Si7021 sensor returns an error code (0xFFFF) over I2C1, the firmware shall transmit 'Error' over USART2.
source: main error handling branch at 0x80012dc-0x80012e6 referencing rodata 'Error' at 0x8001d5c

title: Relative Humidity Physical Range
description: Reported relative humidity shall remain within physical atmospheric sensor bounds between 0% and 100% RH.
source: Si7021 sensor specification and conversion formula at 0x80013d4-0x80013da

title: Temperature Operating Range
description: Reported temperature shall remain within the Si7021 physical operating limits of -40°C to +125°C.
source: Si7021 datasheet operating temperature range and conversion routine at 0x8001320

title: Continuous Execution Integrity
description: The firmware shall execute continuously without triggering HardFault, BusFault, or unexpected reset loops.
source: STM32F407 Cortex-M4 vector table at 0x8000000 and generic reliability requirements
